indications.description: Neoadjuvant or adjuvant muscle-invasive transitional-cell carcinoma, or locally advanced/metastatic urothelial transitional-cell carcinoma; select the specific treatment intent.

treatment.schedule_summary: Methotrexate 30 mg/m² days 1, 15 and 22; vinblastine 3 mg/m² days 2, 15 and 22; doxorubicin 30 mg/m² and cisplatin 70 mg/m² day 2. Every 28 days: neoadjuvant three, adjuvant four, advanced/metastatic up to six cycles.
treatment.duration_text: Three neoadjuvant, four adjuvant, or up to six advanced/metastatic cycles

administration.note: Intravenous only; fatal if given intrathecally.
Confirm cardiac function and cumulative lifetime dose.

options.description: Ambulatory and capable of self-care; up more than half of waking hours.
Limited self-care; bed/chair more than half of waking hours.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
premedication: Confirm each treatment day, blood-test appointments, support medicines and any growth-factor or folinic-acid prescription.
other_support: Use one written anti-sickness plan, including medicines before treatment, tablets for home and rescue treatment. Your team reconciles steroids, interactions and any stomach-protection medicine from your local prescription. Cisplatin needs prescribed intravenous fluids and electrolyte monitoring/replacement. Follow your own fluid advice; tell the team about heart failure or fluid restriction. Review kidney function, hearing, nerves and other medicines before treatment. Methotrexate interacts with several medicines, including some antibiotics, anti-inflammatory painkillers and proton-pump inhibitors. Do not start, stop or combine medicines without oncology/pharmacy advice. The aprepitant–vinblastine interaction also requires pharmacy reconciliation.
